name: Garment
overview: Scripture portrays garments as symbolic of righteousness and salvation, emphasizing the believer's new identity in Christ. Isaiah 61:10 describes God clothing His people with the 'robe of righteousness,' while Revelation 7:14 highlights robes made white by the blood of the Lamb, signifying purity through Christ's sacrifice. The warnings in Matthew 22:11 and Revelation 16:15 stress the necessity of being properly clothed in righteousness to avoid shame, and Revelation 19:8 connects fine linen directly to the righteousness of the saints. This theme underscores the believer's need to be spiritually clothed by Christ's righteousness, reflecting holiness and readiness before God.
